regulated_question.prompt: Do you handle human patient health records?
regulated_question.help: If yes, HIPAA applies and any vendor touching patient data must sign a BAA. Veterinary clinics answer no: HIPAA does not directly cover animal care.

regulated_question.prompt: Do you prepare tax returns for clients?
regulated_question.help: Federal tax law (IRC section 7216) requires written client consent before tax return data goes to outside tools.
ABA Formal Opinion 512 asks lawyers to protect client information and consult clients about AI use.
